# Coast Path Ride

Two day bike trip from Porthbay to Wrenhaven, 142 km in total with 2,300 m of climbing.

## Day one

Left at 7 am. The climb out of Porthbay is 4 km at 8 percent and it hurt on a loaded bike. Lunch at the harbour cafe in Kettle Cove. Camped at Gull Point, which had a cold tap but no showers.

## Day two

Headwind all morning. Front tyre punctured near the lighthouse, fixed with the spare tube in about 15 minutes. Arrived in Wrenhaven at 4 pm.

## Kit notes

Next time bring two spare tubes, not one, and a lighter tent. The 32 mm tyres were fine on the gravel sections. Tested the [[Lighthouse App]] at the north beach and it worked with no signal.
